title: Building Terms from a Root
goal: Build and decode specialised nouns and verbs from a root and a suffix.
grammar: noun and verb derivation in specialised language

items: I can name a process with a noun built from a verb or an adjective (*fermentar → fermentación*).
I can build a verb from a noun or an adjective (*estable → estabilizar*, *puro → purificar*).
I can decode a verb built with a prefix and a suffix (*barato → abaratar*, *ancho → ensanchar*).
